title: Pure Grass
description: A clean and lightweight texture pack that enhances Minecraft’s grass with smoother, brighter, and more vibrant visuals while preserving the vanilla style.
body:
Pure Grass is a simple and visually refined texture pack designed to improve the appearance of Minecraft’s grass while maintaining the game’s original vanilla aesthetic. With smoother textures, brighter tones, and more vibrant colors, the pack creates cleaner and more visually appealing landscapes throughout the world.

Built with a lightweight and minimal design approach, Pure Grass enhances the environment without overwhelming the classic Minecraft feel. The refreshed grass textures help worlds appear more lively and polished, making exploration, building, and gameplay feel more immersive and aesthetically pleasing.

Perfect for Bedwars, PvP, survival, and casual gameplay, Pure Grass delivers a subtle yet effective visual upgrade for players who prefer a cleaner and more vibrant Minecraft experience. 🌿✨
